name: Infant Ramworm
special: Carnivorous species of sandworm. Ambushes from below sand. Sharp, armoured head resembles the ram mounted on the prow of an ancient warship.
combat_note: Per adventure room text (9-Worm Corral): kept unfed for weeks, will attack anything stepping onto the sand; pursues prey onto solid ground but moves much slower when exposed.
